title: New Nomination & Remuneration Committee
description: Board sets a new lineup for the Nomination and Remuneration Committee.

title: Extra technical services for Iernut CCGT project
description: Board approves an addendum that increases the contract value for extra GE technical services.

title: Start of drilling in Neptun Deep
description: OMV Petrom and Romgaz announce the start of drilling for Pelican Sud and Domino gas fields.

title: AGM approves 2025 budget and board changes
description: AGM approves the 2025 budget, revokes two board members and appoints two provisional members.

title: New Board chair and committees
description: Board appoints Dumitru Chisăliță as chair and updates advisory committees.

title: Dividend 0.1568 RON per share approved
description: AGM approves a total gross dividend of 0.1568 RON per share for shareholders.

title: Board member resignation
description: Board takes note of Cornel Benchea resigning as provisional director, effective 15 May 2025.

title: Closure of Drobeta Turnu Severin branch
description: Board approves closing and deregistering the Drobeta Turnu Severin branch.

title: Fitch confirms BBB- rating
description: Fitch Ratings maintains the company’s BBB- rating with negative outlook.

title: Iernut project financing extended
description: Addendum to the Iernut financing contract extends availability to 30 June 2026 and updates the schedule.

title: AGM approves KPIs and selection plan
description: AGM approves KPIs for managers and the selection plan for vacant board positions.

title: KPI addenda and Risk Committee updated
description: Board signs KPI addenda to directors’ mandates and sets a new Risk Management Committee.

title: Romgaz Trading SRL in Moldova approved
description: EGM approves setting up Romgaz Trading SRL in Chișinău, Republic of Moldova.

title: MoU with Electrica on renewables
description: Romgaz and Electrica sign a memorandum to develop up to 400 MW of renewables and storage.

title: Decision to terminate Iernut CCGT contract
description: Board agrees to terminate the Iernut CCGT construction contract due to contractor non-compliance.

title: Updated EMTN base prospectus approved
description: Board approves updating the EMTN base prospectus and filing it to the Luxembourg regulator.

title: Digital well monitoring contract with Weatherford
description: Romgaz signs an eight-year contract for a cloud-based, AI-supported well monitoring system.

title: Iernut CCGT contract effectively terminated
description: The Iernut CCGT design and construction contract officially ends after the earlier termination decision.

title: Action filed at CJEU on CO₂ rules
description: Romgaz brings an action before the EU Court of Justice challenging new EU rules on CO₂ storage obligations.

title: Decarbonization Strategy approved
description: Board approves the company’s decarbonization strategy aligned with European climate objectives.

title: Fitch rating review
description: Fitch again confirms the BBB- rating with negative outlook for Romgaz.

title: Second EMTN bond issue subscribed
description: Romgaz prices a 500m EUR, six-year bond with 4.625% coupon under its EMTN programme.
